advisories.finding: 16,384 bounds padded input slots, not GPU allocator bytes or OS RSS. Native SDPA can choose fused/unfused heuristics; shape-dependent actual peaks must be measured and reported.

score_batch docstring says no graph reuse across requests. Native MLX-LM swiglu uses mx.compile(shapeless=True), so this is too broad. Restrict the claim to no input/KV/result caching; native compiled kernel reuse is part of a warm runtime.

Resident caller must release both the engine and returned model/weights tuple before clear_cache, because the scorer lambda retains model. Verify clean shutdown/allocator state in actual worker receipts.

checks.actual_accounting: Distinct attempted/completed batch-forward and pair counters record one B-way execution as one forward and B pairs. Every scorer attempt has started followed by completed or failed receipt; failed scalar validation does not increment completion. Completed token totals split real and allocated slots.
checks.bounded_schedule: Allowed sizes1,2,4,8; <=50 pairs/request; each pair<=8192 tokens; actual B*L<=16384. Greedy ascending-length grouping rejects a sequence over its requested token budget rather than dropping it. Stable original index breaks length ties.
checks.checkpoint_runtime: The loader calls unchanged original checkpoint verification with weight hashing before load, uses strict native model weights and original PairBuilder/instruction. Installed Qwen3, base and rope source hashes plus runtime versions are checked; supporting imported origins are checked. No Hub loader, network, quantization, replacement architecture or source metadata injection is introduced.
checks.error_ownership: Loaded model and weights are returned to caller, while engine scorer closure also retains model. Batch arrays are local and successful results are only Python scalar/source-identity metadata; loader exception clears local model/weights and MLX cache. Resident shutdown must release engine closure plus returned ownership references and clear allocator cache.
checks.final_token_gather: hidden[rows,positions,:] selects each n-1 index, then adds the singleton sequence axis before the tied embedding projection. Shape checks require exactly B,1 before reading yes/no logits; no full-sequence vocabulary head is projected.
checks.native_attention: Qwen3 reshapes attention to B,head,L,dim and no cache is provided. Qwen3Model calls create_attention_mask(h,None), returning causal for L>1. MLX fast SDPA documents lower-right causal alignment, which is j<=i here because query/key lengths are equal. No mixing across batch examples occurs.
checks.original_order: Each original index appears once in planned groups. Scored rows are written back into results[index]. Receipts bind pair_index, source/query/delivered hashes and exact input-token hashes, so scheduling does not alter external candidate identity.
checks.padding_isolation: Right padding retains each real prefix at identical positions 0..n-1. A real query i<n cannot attend future padded keys j>=n; per-token RMSNorm/MLP and residual paths preserve this through all layers. Padded query outputs are never selected or fed into any real earlier state.
checks.parity_plan: Document freezes internal BF16 bounds and near-tie inversion/top-five checks before inference, including varied lengths, peer reorder/duplicate, Unicode and full-line clipping. Fake tests cannot establish native numerical parity; old rankings cannot substitute for actual batched scoring/packing.
checks.rope: Pinned config has rope_scaling=null, sliding_window=null, tie_word_embeddings=true. initialize_rope selects nn.RoPE; no-cache attention calls RoPE with its default offset0. There is no length-dependent dynamic RoPE for this checkpoint.
checks.singleton_exactness: Every singleton, including singleton remainder in a B>1 schedule, calls unchanged prototype.score_pair with identical builder input, no padding and original final slice. B1 plans keep original candidate order.

classification: Independent static batch scorer and pinned native API review; no inference
limitations: No model weights loaded or pair inference performed; static causal reasoning and fake tests do not certify BF16 numerical parity, warm latency, native peak memory, end-to-end resident cleanup or retrieval quality.
This review covers the bound source hashes. Later source changes require a review update or independent recheck before use.
reviewer: fresh_corpus independent agent, not batch source author
scope: Static implementation and injected contracts only; actual resident numeric parity is a required subsequent gate
